description: This file defines Express.js route handlers related to user session management, including listing tenants, setting active tenant, and toggling global tenant visibility. It handles authentication middleware, interacts with audit logs, and manages cookies for tenant selection.

methods.name: GET /api/session/tenants
methods.description: List authorized tenants for the current user, with audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/session/tenant
methods.description: Set the active tenant in the session or token context, with RBAC validation and audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/tenants/select
methods.description: Alias for setting active tenant, reusing the /tenant handler.

methods.name: POST /api/session/all-tenants
methods.description: Toggle global tenant filter mode for super admins, with audit logging.
